candidate.corridor_edge_ids: ragged int32; empty for hold and unclassified policy candidates
candidate.first_branch_side: nullable enum: left | right | straight; null for hold
candidate.path_local_xy_m: float32 [num_points, 2], current body frame, first point [0, 0]
candidate.topology_class_id: nullable string, hash of ordered corridor-graph edge ids

pairwise_preference.reason_mask: collision, safety margin, progress, clearance, or closed-loop tracking dominance
pairwise_preference.rule: store only Pareto-dominant pairs; do not invent a weighted scalar utility

state.sample_id: string, foreign key to v2 samples.jsonl

storage: per-scene ragged NPZ shards plus JSONL state index; observations and task_goal remain referenced by immutable v2 sample_id
